title: Email Statements - discontinuation of physical statements
text: I/We agree to discontinue the Physical Statements being sent to me.

title: Email Statements - convenience facility and no liability for breach of secrecy
text: I/We understand that the email statements are for my/our convenience. HDFC Bank shall not be liable or responsible for any breach of secrecy because the statements are being sent to the registered email ID.

title: Email Statements - authenticity verification and no liability for fraud or network issues
text: I/We shall verify the authenticity of the emails I/We receive. I/We shall not hold the Bank responsible for any statement received from frauds/imposters. I/We shall not hold the Bank liable if any problem arises with my/our computer network because of me/us receiving statements from the Bank.

title: Email Statements - authorisation by other holders to receive statements
text: I/We are authorised by the other holders to receive the Statements in the registered email address.

title: Email Statements - obligation to inform Bank of information changes
text: I/We shall inform the Bank in writing if there is any change in the information given.

title: Email Statements - no liability for non-receipt due to incorrect email or technical reasons
text: The Bank shall not be responsible if I/we do not receive statement due to incorrect email address and technical reasons.

title: Email Statements - confirmation of having read and understood terms
text: I/We confirm to have read and understood the Terms & Conditions.

title: Email Statements - registration overrides past Hold Statement facility
text: This registration will override any "Hold Statement" facility availed in the past.

title: Email Statements - authorization to send statements and Customer ID linkage
text: I/We authorize the Bank to send the monthly statement of account to our email id as mentioned in the account opening form. I/We understand that all accounts linked to the Customer ID of the 1st applicant will be registered for Free Email Statements.

title: Email Statements - Important Note: primary account holder Customer ID
text: The Customer ID registered should be of the primary account holder only.

title: Email Statements - Important Note: no dispatch for secondary holder registration
text: Email Statements will not be dispatched in case a secondary account holder registers for the facility.

title: Email Statements - Important Note: NRI combined statement discontinuation and programme-based combined statements
text: For NRI / NRI Preferred Banking customers, who are currently availing combined monthly statement facility (across Savings, Current and Fixed Deposits), the combined statements would be discontinued and he/she shall receive separate email statements for only Savings and Current Accounts, where he/she is the first holder. Customers covered under Imperia, Preferred and Classic programmes will receive combined email statement for all accounts (across Savings, Current and Fixed Deposits) linked to the primary customer id. Combined Email Statement facility is available with monthly frequency only.

title: Email Statements - Important Note: FD advice via email and discontinuation of physical advice
text: For Email Statement registered customers, FD advice will be sent through email. Physical advice will be discontinued. In case you wish to have a physical advice, you are requested to visit the nearest HDFC branch.

title: Email Statements - Important Note: Current Account Company Customer ID registration
text: For Current Accounts the Customer ID of the Company should be registered.

title: Email Statements - Important Note: applicable account types
text: The facility is applicable for Savings Account, Current Account and Fixed Deposits only.

title: Email Statements - Important Note: monthly frequency only
text: The facility is available with monthly frequency only.
